title: November 1 escrow eligibility: refreshed page still uses a pre-event validated-ledger snapshot

tracker.temporal_interpretation: The page combines a current eligibility statement with a pinned ledger observation from 38 minutes before eligibility. The pinned ledger cannot establish post-00:00 execution or non-execution.

owner_pages.interpretation: Pages appear stale or incomplete; not same-ledger corroboration and not evidence against a validated XRPL transaction.

raw_post_eligibility_verification.status: NOT_OBTAINED; ABSENCE OF RETRIEVED DATA IS NOT NEGATIVE EVIDENCE

source_evidence.supports: Pinned ledger 108033174 at 23:22 UTC, schedule, 31.4B XRP in 98 objects, and page's mixed-time eligibility text.
Account page renders 500M XRP, no transaction history, no escrow objects and last activity six months ago; freshness is inadequate.
account_objects returns raw ledger entries for a specified ledger; validated status and ledger index are required.
A transaction must be in a validated ledger and its metadata/AffectedNodes establish the resulting state.
account_tx retrieves validated transactions involving an account.

access_and_method_limitations: The latest page's pinned ledger is 38 minutes before eligibility, despite the page's current eligibility text.
The XRPL Explorer pages require JavaScript and did not expose raw ledger objects.
Direct public JSON-RPC POST was not available through the browser retrieval path; container network name resolution also failed.
XRPSCAN public GET endpoint documentation was reviewed, but direct account API URLs were inaccessible through the browser tool.
No transaction hash surfaced in web search; search-result absence is not evidence of non-execution.
No private credentials, account keys, deception or unauthorized access were used.
correction_note: Append-only validator repair copy. Original preserved; ledger pointer redirected to this corrected copy. Source claim and observation unchanged.
